hero.tagline: Growth - Tech - Education Enthusiast | Community Builder | Solo Traveler
hero.intro: Hi, I'm Haley - a free spirit, a lifelong learner, and someone who believes the best lessons often happen outside the classroom. Since 16, I have been taking solo trips across Southeast Asia, hitchhiking and sleeping on strangers' couches. Along the way, I grew endlessly curious about people and cultures: how they live, what they value, and how I can create impact to change people's lives.
